## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `hubspot-crm-obj-leads-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a HubSpot developer account

1. <!-- manual: Go to [HubSpot Developer Portal](https://developers.hubspot.com/) and sign in. -->
2. Select **Create developer account** if you do not already have one, or log in with your existing HubSpot credentials.
3. Once logged in, navigate to **Apps** in the top navigation bar.

## Step 3: Create a private app (API key: quickest setup)

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your HubSpot account (not the developer portal). -->
2. Select **Settings** gear icon in the top navigation bar.
3. <!-- manual: In the left sidebar, navigate to Integrations → Private Apps. -->
4. Select **Create a private app**.
5. <!-- manual: On the Basic Info tab, enter a name and (optionally) a description for your app. -->
6. <!-- manual: Switch to the Scopes tab and add the following scopes: -->
7. <!-- manual: crm.objects.leads.read -->
8. <!-- manual: crm.objects.leads.write -->
9. Select **Create app**, then confirm by clicking **Continue creating**.
10. <!-- manual: Copy the generated Access Token; this is your privateApp token. -->

## Step 4: Create a public app for OAuth 2.0

1. <!-- manual: In the HubSpot Developer Portal, go to Apps and click Create app. -->
2. <!-- manual: Under App Info, provide an App name and (optionally) a description and logo. -->
3. <!-- manual: Navigate to the Auth tab. -->
4. Note the **Client ID** and **Client secret**; you will need these later.
5. <!-- manual: Under Redirect URLs, add a redirect URI (e.g., https://your-app.com/oauth/callback). -->
6. <!-- manual: Under Scopes, add the following required scopes: -->
7. <!-- manual: crm.objects.leads.read -->
8. <!-- manual: crm.objects.leads.write -->
9. Select **Save changes**.
